findings: Missing FSM guard on transfer_confirm_yes — the callback has no state filter, so a stale confirm button from a prior session can trigger a transfer attempt from any state. Add AdminFlow.transfer_confirm to the decorator, matching how transfer_disable_yes is guarded.

Container status check fragility — docker compose ps --format '{{.State}}' | head -1 compared to 'running' fails silently on multi-service stacks and on Compose versions that emit empty leading lines, causing the 120-second timeout to run out on a healthy deployment. Replace with docker compose ps --quiet | grep -c . or equivalent.

.env source path not surfaced to admin — cat SOURCE_DIR/.env is executed inside the source container's filesystem; the admin receives no progress message showing which file path was actually read, making it impossible to confirm the right .env was transferred before docker compose up runs on the destination.
